name: caracol-derby
description: Dashboard de apuestas simuladas en carreras de caracoles con pasarela de pagos mock (SnailPay).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
